Class TuiRunner.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.TuiRunner.Builder
Enclosing class:
TuiRunner
public static final class TuiRunner.Builder extends Object
Builder for TuiRunner instances.

Provides a fluent API for configuring the TUI application including bindings, event handlers, renderers, and auto-registration of annotated action handlers.

    • autoBindingRegistration

      public TuiRunner.Builder autoBindingRegistration(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables automatic registration of action handlers.

      When enabled, methods annotated with @OnAction on the event handler object are automatically registered.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enable auto-registration
      Returns:
      this builder

    • resizeGracePeriod

      public TuiRunner.Builder resizeGracePeriod(Duration resizeGracePeriod)
      Sets the resize grace period.

      This defines the maximum time before resize events are processed, ensuring the UI redraws promptly on terminal resize even when ticks are disabled or have a long interval.

      Parameters:
      resizeGracePeriod - the grace period, or null to disable automatic resize handling
      Returns:
      this builder
